name: Sanzu
source:
A member of the Bad Apples. A girl with a cool atmosphere. The tea she brews is delicious. She's the one to keep discipline between the members. The thing she always brings to school are her headphones.

[From [url=http://www.otomate.jp/baw/chara/]Official site[/url]]
